cmqwkgem104dknwqoov3w66jv.entry: Final-year or graduated high-school students may apply with their high-school diploma. You qualify with a high-school average of at least 50% (accepted for all programmes) — or, instead, with one of the exams/diplomas in Annex 1 of the 8 April 2025 directive, e.g. SAT 1000/1600, ACT 18/36, TR-YÖS 200/500, IB 26/45, Abitur 3.5/4, Baccalaureate 60% (12/20), Tawjihi 55/100, two A Levels at AA, US high-school diploma 3.00/4.00. cmqwkgem104dknwqoov3w66jv.language: A Turkish certificate is not required to apply. Otherwise you take the university Turkish exam and, if below level, a one-year Turkish preparatory programme (one more year allowed).
documents: High-school diploma or graduation certificate (final-year students: official letter from the school); Turkish or English, otherwise notarised translation
At registration: original diploma, transcript, passport, equivalence certificate (Denklik; an undertaking allows submission later), tuition payment receipt and photographs
